name: Ledger Live
description: Ledger Live’s non-store updater includes SHA-512 integrity checks and signature verification with key rotation chained from a pinned EC key. Store distributions use a separate channel; release and platform coverage remain bounded to the inspected snapshot.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study checkout; this review did not validate released artifacts, endpoint deployment, or platform-specific packaging behavior beyond the checked store-distribution branch.
